fields.name: properties.fd:submit.actionName
fields.label: Submit action
fields.description: Forms Submission Service uses the submission configuration sheet; a REST endpoint receives submissions at the Submit URL.

fields.name: properties.fd:submit.configUrl
fields.label: Submission configuration sheet
fields.description: Path of a published sheet of this site (e.g. /forms/contact-submit) with a 'default' sheet holding the Submit row (Action pointing to the sheet itself) and submit-action-spreadsheet / submit-action-email sheets.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Submit URL
fields.description: Endpoint that receives the submission when the submit action is REST endpoint.
